comparison.objective: Stretch an O-ring over a threaded hydraulic plug and seat it untwisted in its groove; candidate transfers a rigid uncaged bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record manipulates a deformable ring while limiting stretch and twist. Candidate aligns rigid supports and slides a block while preserving free rolling elements.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires groove seating with irreversible over-stretch and damage limits. Candidate requires complete transfer, all balls retained and no interface gap, jam, impact or contamination.
comparison.reason: Deformable seal installation tests strain and twist control, not rolling-element support continuity.
